purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) system – patient insurance combination lookup subprogram
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCGQSUB03) retrieves insurance combination information for a patient given a hospital ID, patient ID, and visit date. It checks inpatient admission records first, then outpatient visit records, and resolves the applicable insurance combination name and number, returning results via the linkage section.

notable_features: CALL 'ORCMCPSUB' for DB SELECT/FETCH/CLOSE cursor operations (ORCA middleware)
COPY of multiple .INC copybooks (CPJYURRK, CPSRYKARRK, CPPTNYUINRRK, CPHKNCOMBI, MCPDATA, CPORCMCP, MCPAREA, CPQSUB03)
LINKAGE SECTION with QSUB03-LNK parameter block
PERFORM UNTIL loop for cursor fetch iteration
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary ORCMCPSUB abstraction layer
High comment ratio (41%) with Japanese-language comments
verdict.notes: Source contains Latin-1 encoded Japanese text (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS stored as latin-1 bytes) in comments and data names. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. No truncation observed; all four COBOL divisions present.
